args.query: SNAP participation enrollment by state monthly

sql: SELECT "year","month",SUM(persons_participating) p, COUNT(*) n FROM fiscal.snap_benefits_by_geography WHERE "year" IN (2025,2026) AND month IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "year","month" ORDER BY "year","month"
SELECT * FROM fiscal.snap_benefits_by_geography WHERE "year"=2026 AND "month"=5 AND persons_participating IS NOT NULL ORDER BY persons_participating DESC FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY

SELECT state_abbr, SUM(CASE WHEN "year"=2025 AND "month"=6 THEN persons_participating END) jun25, SUM(CASE WHEN "year"=2026 AND "month"=4 THEN persons_participating END) apr26, SUM(CASE WHEN "year"=2026 AND "month"=5 THEN persons_participating END) may26, SUM(CASE WHEN "year"=2026 AND "month"=6 THEN persons_participating END) jun26 FROM fiscal.snap_benefits_by_geography WHERE state_abbr IN ('GA','TX','IL','NY','MI','FL','VA','AZ','TN','CO','CA','AK','ND') GROUP BY state_abbr ORDER BY state_abbr

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "year"=2025 AND "month"=6 THEN persons_participating END) jun25, SUM(CASE WHEN "year"=2026 AND "month"=5 THEN persons_participating END) may26 FROM fiscal.snap_benefits_by_geography WHERE state_abbr NOT IN ('PR','GU','VI','AS','MP')
SELECT SUM(total_benefits_usd)/1e9 b_bn, COUNT(*) n FROM fiscal.snap_benefits_by_geography WHERE "year"=2025 AND month IS NULL
